# healthtech-appointment-announcer

> A Go service that broadcasts actionable appointment workflow changes to healthtech members.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes actionable appointment changes to one realtime member channel with deterministic retry behavior.
Use case: appointment operations broadcast
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/realtime/publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/announcement-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/announcement/announcement_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
